defects.where: THE COURTYARD — the whole 50 x 35 m lawn heightfield, and the fountain water at [0, 0.95, 30].
defects.did: Walked out of the south doors onto the lawn, then listed every terrain and water mesh the live course had built.
defects.happened: EVERY TERRAIN QUADRANT AND THE FOUNTAIN WATER ARE BUILT TWICE, COINCIDENT. The scene holds two complete sets — terrain.0,0 / 1,0 / 0,1 / 1,1 with their .far LODs, identical bounding boxes, both visible — two grass instancers, and two 'water.pool' meshes both at bbox [-4.2, 0.95, 25.8]..[4.2, 0.95, 34.2]. The cause is in the data wiring: def.terrain is set AND def.objects also contains a kind:'terrain' entry; def.waters has one entry AND def.objects also contains a kind:'water' entry, so course.js builds each one a second time. Two coplanar ground meshes z-fight (the streaky banding the owner photographed) and two coincident transparent water planes double the alpha, which is why the pool reads as a flat opaque cyan sheet with no ripple and no shore foam.
defects.should: One terrain, one water. Either drop the duplicate entries from def.objects or make course.js skip terrain/water kinds it has already built from def.terrain/def.waters.

defects.where: THE GALLERY, library nook, standing 1.2 m from Old Fen at [18.20, 6.30, -21.00].
defects.did: Walked up to Fen and stood still.
defects.happened: The follow camera collapses to dist 1.94 and ends up INSIDE Nim's head: the frame is the back of his skull and Fen's torso, looking almost straight down at the floorboards. You cannot see the NPC you are standing in front of. Note that this PASSES camcheck, whose rule is dist >= TUNE.cam.minDist (1.60) — the number is legal and the frame is unusable, which is exactly the class of bug the owner is complaining about. Walking through interiors is fine by comparison (measured camDist over ten frames: library nook 5.14-6.79, long hall 5.44-6.80, undercroft 6.31-6.80, gallery west leg 6.75-6.80) — the collapse happens when you STOP near geometry.
defects.should: In a tight interior the camera tilts over the head rather than pushing through it, and the hero never fills the frame.

worked: P0 IS CLOSED on this build. Held W for 1.4 s at state 'title' and the hero moved 0.00 m — the title-screen input leak is gone. NEW GAME puts the game in state 'keep'.
All 13 gates report real booleans: verdant-1 unlocked=true sealed=false, the other 12 unlocked=false sealed=true.

GATE ENTRY WORKS END TO END. Walking into verdant-1 raises the BAILEY MEADOW card and ENTER loads verdant-1. With the save unlocked, verdant-2 -> GNASHER FORT -> loads verdant-2, ember-2 -> PISTON HALLS -> ember-2, rime-2 -> GLACIER SLIDE -> rime-2, azure-1 -> TIDEWELL TEMPLE -> azure-1, azure-3 -> PRISM RIDE. Every SEALED gate explains itself by name and price the moment you walk into it: GNASHER FORT 1 CREST, WINDMILL HEIGHTS 3, MAGMA WORKS 5, PISTON HALLS 8, CINDER CHASE 12, SUNSCAR NECROPOLIS 15, FROST COTTAGE 18, GLACIER SLIDE 22, BLIZZARD PEAK 26, TIDEWELL TEMPLE 30.

The secret grate works: jump then ground pound at [-13.5, 0, 0.9] breaks through and drops you into the undercroft, and the undercroft checkpoint fires.

The 23-tread spiral stair between the undercroft and the lobby is fully walkable in BOTH directions — climbed y -7.67 to the top tread at -0.33 and stepped east onto the lobby floor at 0.00. It is the only working vertical link in the building.

The gallery walkway does close its loop, around the NORTH side of the void (z -13.80..-8.34 at x -5..5). The south side is correctly severed by the stair slot and its balustrades — that is authored, not a bug.

Swimming works: jumping the 1.10 m rim lands you in the water, the swim states drive, and a surface hop gets you back out over the rim (measured out at y 1.10 after four tries). The water surface mesh is at y 0.95, correctly 0.15 m BELOW the 1.10 m rim — the 'overflowing' look is the doubled mesh in K2, not a wrong height.
The balcony -> garden loft long jump works and is tuned right: 8.40 m/s of run-up falls short, 9.00 m/s clears the 6.00 m gap and lands on the loft.

The wall-kick tower is climbable across its 3.0 m x-axis — reached y 6.96, past the 3.23 and 6.43 ledges. Kicking along the 5.65 m z-axis correctly does nothing, since that span is wider than the 3.4 m shaft limit.

The course card is genuinely good: realm tag, difficulty pips, seven named crest slots, coin/time/death tallies, keyboard AND gamepad hints. The CRESTWAY gate at the end of the courtyard is a real set-piece.
Nothing in the Keep killed me in any of the eighteen runs, including a 12 m fall off the tower and an 8 m drop down the open stair well — the 'the hub cannot kill you' promise holds.
No console or page errors in any run.
